note: [operator decision 2026-11-11, Thursday-planning doc] b1 1h promotions tlt/qqq/slv/uso -> verbatim choice "Put qqq and tlt on the paper floor now; promote tlt to real money". Operator note, verbatim: "We need to make sure these proposals don't stay una Ted on, why aren't you getting an alert when the proposal is ready to send me the decision?" ROOT CAUSE (2026-11-11 read, lane thursday-planning; file:line from the read, not re-run): PROMOTE-1H-SURVIVORS-20261104 was a checklist BUILD row (owner manager, tier 3), not a pipeline ask_operator item. Every surfacing path missed it: scripts/ops/attention_watch.py (~l.192, ~l.965) pushes only on pipeline next_action == ask_operator; scripts/ops/render_daily_brief.py:376-388 (section 2, decisions for you) lists only rows whose OWNER contains "operator"; :245-250 (section 0) prints overdue build rows as a bare COUNT, never by id. Nothing converts "lane finished, operator must decide" into a record those readers see; the hand-back lived as prose in the row note. (The 11-04 lane also found no leg cleared every check, and nothing surfaced that either.) FIX (routes and alerts only, refuses nothing): one awaits_operator(row) predicate in src/runtime/checklist_store.py on structured fields only (ask_operator; owner operator; blocked_on kind operator; tier>=3 and past due_by; a lane hand-back field when set) used by render_daily_brief decisions_for_you, section 0 (list overdue ids), and attention_watch (read the work store, file fallback; edge-triggered ping, re-alert after 48h). Tests: tests/test_render_daily_brief.py + attention_watch --self-test, positive control = the real PROMOTE-1H row JSON.
